# Gold Coast’s leading prestige real estate and project marketing agencies

For luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses and architecturally distinctive residences on the Gold Coast, I’d focus on agencies with a demonstrable track record in **high-value apartment launches, developer relationships, premium buyer databases and project positioning** — rather than residential prestige sales alone.

Based on current agency portfolios, specialist project marketing experience and publicly documented development work, these are the strongest candidates to shortlist. This is a qualitative assessment, not an independently audited ranking of sales volume or market share.

(Luxury project specialist)

**Best for\:** Landmark towers, premium off-the-plan apartments and luxury penthouses.

Led by Deborah Provost, the agency highlights more than 25 years of project marketing experience and a portfolio that includes major Gold Coast developments such as Soul and Q1. Its specialist focus makes it one of the first agencies I would approach for a high-profile development launch. **9\. Off Market Brokerage (OMB)**

**Best for\:** Individual ultra-premium apartments, final unsold penthouses and bespoke buyer-facing sales experiences.

OMB focuses on improving the sales experience and market intelligence for high-value residences, particularly where generic development campaigns are not converting buyers. Importantly, it states that it is not a licensed real estate agency, so it should be considered a specialist complement to an appointed selling agent rather than a substitute. ## Which agencies lead in each category?

| Your priority | My first agencies to approach |
|--------|--------|
| Landmark off-the-plan towers | DP Project Marketing, TOTAL Property Group |
| Design-led boutique developments | New Projects Agency, JW Prestige Agents |
| Full development marketing and sales strategy | Pezet Matheson, DP Project Marketing |
| Trophy penthouses and ultra-luxury apartments | Kollosche, Lucy Cole Prestige |
| Individual architectural residences | Tomain Residences |
| Bespoke campaigns for premium unsold stock | OMB, alongside a licensed selling agent |


These are recommendations by specialist fit, not a claim that each firm leads every category by sales volume.

## How I would choose a market leader

For a developer appointing a project marketing agency, I would request evidence of\:

- **Comparable project results\:** Actual sales achieved, price per square metre, time to sell and proportion of stock sold.
- **Penthouse capability\:** Named examples of premium residences sold, not just the overall project’s total sales.
- **Buyer reach\:** Qualified local, interstate and international purchasers, with a clear explanation of how they are accessed.
- **Architectural storytelling\:** Quality of renders, visualisation, branding, show apartments and campaign presentation.
- **Commercial accountability\:** Pricing advice, launch strategy, sales reporting, contract management and settlement support.

The Gold Coast’s luxury market has continued to attract affluent interstate purchasers, but development delivery and construction feasibility are important considerations in the current apartment market. A polished campaign alone is not enough. [www.couriermail.com.au](https://www.couriermail.com.au/property/gold-coast-luxury-property-market-defies-national-downturn-as-wealthy-interstate-buyers-invest/news-story/7e04ade24dcc8907cb6a9ff61953cbfb?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.couriermail.com.au](https://www.couriermail.com.au/real-estate/queensland/brisbane/54bn-apartment-crisis-10000-homes-shelved-across-brisbane-and-gold-coast/news-story/046fc6cde5104c3fbe7e93b271644896?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My starting shortlist would be DP Project Marketing, New Projects Agency and Pezet Matheson** for a developer-led, luxury off-the-plan project, with Kollosche or Lucy Cole added where trophy penthouses and established prestige buyers are central to the mandate.

One question that would help me refine the shortlist: **Are you looking to appoint an agency to market a development, find an agency to sell a single luxury penthouse, or benchmark the Gold Coast’s agencies and their market positions?** The strongest candidates differ depending on that objective.

search_results.title: Ray White TMG Luxury launches amid Gold Coast market downturn
search_results.description: Ray White TMG Luxury has launched amid a downturn in the Gold Coast property market, marked by four interest rate hikes, Middle East conflict, and changes to federal property tax policies. Ray White chief economist Nerida Conisbee remarked on the market’s uncertainty, though noting it is currently easier to transact. The launch featured a premium Broadbeach Waters property at 29 Namatjira Court with 95m of river frontage, 533 sq m of luxury living space, and high-end amenities such as a cocktail lounge and riverside pool. Despite a 3% decline in overall Gold Coast property values over the past year, the luxury segment in Broadbeach Waters remains resilient, mirroring stabilizing trends in Sydney’s Eastern suburbs and Melbourne’s South Yarra and Toorak. The event also marked the official unveiling of Ray White TMG Luxury, a new prestige-focused division led by CEO Matt Micallef. Micallef emphasized the division’s goal to provide a specialist approach for high-end buyers and sellers, asserting the Gold Coast's legitimacy as a top-tier luxury market. The luxury brand aims to respond to growing demand with dedicated, high-caliber service.

search_results.title: Villa Alcyone: Award-winning Elanora mansion eyes suburb record
search_results.description: Villa Alcyone, a Mediterranean-style mansion situated on a steep 890 sqm block at 6 Bicton Ct in Elanora, has entered the market with expectations to surpass the suburb's sales record by millions. Designed by Jayson Pate and built by Resolve Constructions, the award-winning home reflects a growing trend of luxury builders tackling challenging vertical sites. The property garnered multiple accolades at the 2026 HIA Gold Coast and Northern Rivers Awards and a Master Builders Queensland award. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom home spans 579 sqm and features high-end finishes such as Italian marble, dramatic archways, and a Sukabumi stone pool, all inspired by European influences during the owners' travels. Interior design was led by co-owner Helen Foukkare. Positioned to maximize ocean views and offering access to popular nearby beaches like Currumbin and Palm Beach, the mansion is drawing interest from high-end buyers typically focused on more traditionally prestigious areas. Although quarterly data shows a slight dip in Elanora home prices, the suburb's annual values rose 14.7 percent, reflecting its evolving luxury market appeal. The Foukkares are already planning another unique luxury build in the Gold Coast region.

search_results.title: Gold Coast luxury property defies downturn as Sydney buyers move in
search_results.description: Despite a nationwide property downturn that has reverted prices and sales to 2023 levels, the Gold Coast luxury real estate market remains resilient. This strength is attributed to a limited housing supply, robust internal migration, and affluent buyers—particularly from Sydney—seeking better value. Michael Kollosche, managing director of Kollosche, highlights how high-end Gold Coast apartments, priced between $25,000 and $35,000 per square metre, offer better value compared to Sydney's $120,000 per square metre rates. Notable recent sales include an $11.5 million penthouse purchase by a European investor. According to Colliers, Gold Coast property prices have surged 84% since 2021, surpassing Brisbane and Greater Brisbane. Analyst Michael Matusik notes a shift from investment properties to owner-occupied beachfront homes, as the city attracts wealthy buyers post-pandemic. Downsizing among affluent homeowners along Hedges Avenue is driving demand for luxurious, smaller residences in the same prime locations. This demographic shift is shaping a robust, high-end market insulated from broader sectoral declines.

search_results.title: Surfers Paradise mega-penthouse heads to auction as Simon Beard 'meets market'
search_results.description: Simon Beard, founder of Culture Kings, and his wife Tah-nee are putting their luxurious four-level penthouse in Surfers Paradise up for auction after failing to sell it at the original $30 million asking price in 2024. Despite receiving strong offers at the time, Beard held out in hopes of setting a record, a decision he now regrets. With falling national home prices and rising interest rates, the couple is ready to meet the market and sell the property to the highest bidder. The exclusive penthouse atop the Soul building includes five bedrooms, seven bathrooms, panoramic views, a whisky bar, cigar lounge, eight-car garage, balcony gym, and Australia's highest private rooftop pool. Interior highlights feature opulent finishes such as a marble and brass staircase, custom chandeliers, and a $1 million sneaker display. Originally purchased for a record $15.25 million in 2021, the property is listed by agent Tolemy Stevens and will go to private auction on November 20, 2026. The Beards now live in a waterfront mansion nearby with their four children, which they bought for $11.75 million in 2020.

search_results.title: Brisbane, Gold Coast apartment crisis: $5.4bn backlog revealed
search_results.description: A construction crisis has emerged in Brisbane and the Gold Coast, with 112 apartment projects, totaling 10,286 dwellings and valued at $5.4 billion, currently deferred or indefinitely suspended due to soaring construction costs and labor shortages. Brisbane alone accounts for 6,711 apartments across 71 projects ($2.5bn), while the Gold Coast records 3,575 apartments in 41 projects ($2.9bn). PRD chief economist Dr. Diaswati Mardiasmo warns that many approved developments may never be built as construction costs have more than doubled since 2020, and builders are fully booked for years. Major projects like Breakfast Creek Quarter and Urban Forest are on hold, highlighting broader challenges in housing supply. Although some developers affirm their commitment to future delivery, uncertainty prevails. The Property Council of Australia urges policy changes to unlock supply pipelines, warning that approvals alone are insufficient. Meanwhile, risks of buyer settlement defaults loom, with some developers seeking alternative selling strategies. Despite signs of partial recovery in project values, Queensland remains structurally undersupplied, affecting affordability for first-home buyers and renters, and posing long-term challenges for housing availability.

Palmera Residences hits $400m in sales at Northcliffe tower
search_results.description:
Palmera Residences has achieved over $400 million in sales at its Northcliffe tower on the Gold Coast since its relaunch by Central Equity. Originally planned as a 486-unit development, the project was reconfigured to 339 larger luxury apartments, doubling its projected value to $1 billion. Approximately 60% of units have been sold to South East Queenslanders and interstate buyers, with prices ranging from $2.95 million to $8.95 million. Central Equity emphasized that construction, already underway by builder Multiplex, provides buyers with confidence amid broader market challenges like rising costs and labor shortages.

Located on Garfield Terrace between Surfers Paradise and Broadbeach, the development targets owner-occupiers with premium amenities including two swimming pools, a gym, sauna, yoga studio, lounge areas, and concierge services. Urbis data indicates a robust Gold Coast market despite slower sales post-federal budget, with strong buyer preference for credible developers and well-priced offerings. Florence, The Landmark Central Tower, and Corallo were the top-selling projects in the recent quarter. Additionally, Homecorp received approval for Lyon Residences, a $360 million, 32-storey development with 178 units in Budds Beach. The Gold Coast continues to face undersupply as its population grows by over 15,000 annually.

items.markdown:
These are recommendations by specialist fit, not a claim that each firm leads every category by sales volume.

## How I would choose a market leader

For a developer appointing a project marketing agency, I would request evidence of\:

- **Comparable project results\:** Actual sales achieved, price per square metre, time to sell and proportion of stock sold.
- **Penthouse capability\:** Named examples of premium residences sold, not just the overall project’s total sales.
- **Buyer reach\:** Qualified local, interstate and international purchasers, with a clear explanation of how they are accessed.
- **Architectural storytelling\:** Quality of renders, visualisation, branding, show apartments and campaign presentation.
- **Commercial accountability\:** Pricing advice, launch strategy, sales reporting, contract management and settlement support.

The Gold Coast’s luxury market has continued to attract affluent interstate purchasers, but development delivery and construction feasibility are important considerations in the current apartment market. A polished campaign alone is not enough. [www.couriermail.com.au](https://www.couriermail.com.au/property/gold-coast-luxury-property-market-defies-national-downturn-as-wealthy-interstate-buyers-invest/news-story/7e04ade24dcc8907cb6a9ff61953cbfb?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.couriermail.com.au](https://www.couriermail.com.au/real-estate/queensland/brisbane/54bn-apartment-crisis-10000-homes-shelved-across-brisbane-and-gold-coast/news-story/046fc6cde5104c3fbe7e93b271644896?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My starting shortlist would be DP Project Marketing, New Projects Agency and Pezet Matheson** for a developer-led, luxury off-the-plan project, with Kollosche or Lucy Cole added where trophy penthouses and established prestige buyers are central to the mandate.

One question that would help me refine the shortlist: **Are you looking to appoint an agency to market a development, find an agency to sell a single luxury penthouse, or benchmark the Gold Coast’s agencies and their market positions?** The strongest candidates differ depending on that objective.
